title: Council on Aging four-year plan
summary: Office on Aging staff said they would review survey data starting in September and draft plan objectives starting in November, and planned a focus group with the disability community. In September the office said it would gather and analyze survey data and then work on objectives for the four-year plan.

timeline.text: In the next couple of weeks, the office will gather and analyze survey data and then work on objectives for the four-year plan.
Council members will be told the focus group schedule once it is set.
Office staff will reach out to set up a focus group with the disability community.
